_comment: Owner-approved translations that are not in the handoff tables.

notFound.text.en: This page doesn't exist. Your brain does.
notFound.text.id: Halaman ini tidak ada. Otak Anda tetap ada.

newsletter.unavailable.en: That didn't work just now. Please try again later.
newsletter.unavailable.id: Gagal untuk saat ini. Silakan coba lagi nanti.

newsletter.confirmed.text.en: From now on, one lever lands in your inbox once a month. Unsubscribe with one click.
newsletter.confirmed.text.id: Mulai sekarang, sebulan sekali satu trik masuk ke kotak masuk Anda. Berhenti langganan dengan satu klik.

newsletter.expired.text.en: Confirmation links are valid for 48 hours. Just sign up again at the bottom of the website.
newsletter.expired.text.id: Tautan konfirmasi berlaku 48 jam. Silakan daftar lagi di bagian bawah website.

newsletter.mail.body.en: please confirm that you'd like to receive the RIDEFF newsletter. Once a month, one lever hardly anyone knows.
newsletter.mail.body.id: mohon konfirmasi bahwa Anda ingin menerima newsletter RIDEFF. Sebulan sekali, satu trik yang jarang diketahui orang.

newsletter.mail.ignore.en: If you didn't sign up, simply ignore this email. The link is valid for 48 hours.
newsletter.mail.ignore.id: Jika Anda tidak mendaftar, abaikan saja email ini. Tautan berlaku 48 jam.
